title: Will Status Status Mix
dataSources: Trust documents (`trust:document`), will status logs (`will:status`), power-of-attorney records (`poa:record`), and estate review sessions (`estate:review`).
app: Trust document vault exports, will status trackers, power-of-attorney records, and estate review checklists forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=will:status
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(will_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the will status feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `will_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It totals the overall mood of your will status feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
